notes.title: Post-full-release update #2 - Save issue now fixed.
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We now fixed the saving issue.  You can now play the game.  However, for those of you who launched the game a few hours ago when we first posted this patch-note, the save files seem to be gone, and there doesn't seem to be any way for us to retrieve that.  We sincerely apologize for this.  We will be more careful about this from now on.  Again, thousand apologies.

[h1]Added[/h1]
Steam Cloud now added for saving games.
Italian now added. (Special thanks to _Randi_ for the help!)
You can now skip battle animations. You can set it in Option.
Added epilogues for the ending for each hero.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
Your pre-set deck is still kept even if you remove a hero from the party.
Improved the way you can check the details of each card in the deck builder.
You can check the job of your current hero in the deck builder.
You can hide/unhide the Shop pop-up during gameplay so you can check the board.
You can now check a brief explanation of the card slot in-game as well as added an effect when you use it.
The display for the current score for Rush, Collection, and Transport stages is now more prominent.
You can now see the shortcut keys when you hover over the help button.
Deleted the part in the tutorial where you may get stuck.
Deleted afterimages found in some stage intro images.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
Giant bosses now transform more often.
Deleted the cost of refreshing when you visit a card seller at the campfire.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed the bug of not giving +1 LVL.. even if you occupy Minion Tower.
Fixed the Kit-Cat. It now deals double damage.
Fixed the bug where you can't end turn in certain situations.
Fixed the bug where the description for the skill of each hero is not displayed in the party setup menu.

[h1]Known issues and issues we are currently working on.[/h1]
The mouse cursor leaves the game window while it's in the fullscreen mode.
The bug that takes you to a wrong space when you jump to the opposite direction of your moving direction.
Usable cards are not highlighted in green in certain situations.
Game freezes when you press alt+tab while in fullscreen or loading.
Unable to change the resolutions when the game is played on Mac PCs.
Currently working on German localization for the cards.  
If you want to help us with Russian/Chinese/Portuguese, please send an email to master@fakedice.com!

Thanks,
Fakedice

notes.title: Officially Fully Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wVWhjBB.jpg[/img]
Hey guys,

The Full Release version is finally up, and DICETINY is officially fully-released!  I will keep the announcement short because it's 3am here and to be honest we're kind of sleepy. =p

Ok so here comes the usual stuff.  The patch note.

[h1]Added[/h1]
All stages are now open!
Achievements are now open!
Added Credits!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
The rule for betrayal adjusted. (Only applies to the Betrayal mode)
- When you land on an enemy minion, you lose 10 gold times its level.
- While in this mode, all the minions' chance for hiring and cost for hiring are void.
- Sneak Attack: It now deals 2 damage to all minions on the same board. Deals 4 instead if the minion is Good.


[h1]Others[/h1]
- Shortcut keys implemented. (Press F1)
- You get three basic cards at the beginning instead of two.
- Fullscreen [Windowed] mode added. This is the default setting now.
- You get GEM when you clear a stage the second time around.
- You now get an option to reply a stage after you clear it and others....

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Adjusted the alignment of party members at Party Setup screen.
- Fixed the issue of Hex Drinker not leveling up.
And other nameless bugs....

Alright guys, see you later!
Fakedice

notes.title: 2016/06/28 Hotfix!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/H6TdTik.jpg[/img]
[i]This is one of the new cards added today. He resembles someone very famous...well at least in the 90s.[/i]


Hi guys,

Here's the details of today's hotfix!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
Starting Bonus:  +1 AP effect is now permanent.
When giving Level to a minion or the level of a minion increases, its base level increases.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[b]Battle Log:  When you hover over a text in the battle log, 
you can see the details of it.[/b]
[b]The images for all the minion cards are now applied. No more stupid dummy images.[/b]
Improved the accessibility of the tutorial and its system.
Improved the AI of enemy heroes in regard to hiring minions.
Improved the card draw animation at the beginning.
Improved the special effect indicating the moving direction.
Apply effects to the dice roll.
Fixed some misspellings and grammar errors.

[h1]Fixed bugs[/h1]
Fixed some spell attack errors that occurred in intersection type stages.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when your hero teleports to an intersecting space.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when the card Shadow Step was used in a certain situation.
Fixed a Frog Splash bug that caused your hero to jump to the current space instead when it's supposed to jump to the next space.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to progress the game when a certain spell is used while being on a space with a minion or the spell tower.

notes.title: The Update is Now Live! Defeat Beerholder!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lftdFPs.jpg[/img]
Hey guys, as I mentioned before this update will help us decide when to fully launch the game so please give us a lot of feedback/reports, and hopefully you guys enjoy the new update!  Now, here's the patch note.

[h1]Added the Nasty Big Boss "Beerholder"[/h1]
You can take up to three heroes and battle this guy working as a team!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/T9UN1NV.gif[/img]
[i]Hideous![/i]

[h1]Added Party System.[/h1]
- Setup a party consisting of three heroes.
- Only one of three heroes can be played in a typical stage.  
- However!, as I mentioned above, in the boss stage, all three heroes can participate.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5l8PsJ9.jpg[/img]

Added Tutorial for beginners.
Added new stages. (13 main, 5 sub)
We're aiming for 24 stages in total at full launch. Crazy!
The World Map: Now it looks nice and shiny with some fancy animation.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KGhB72R.jpg[/img]

[h1]Added 54 New Minion/Spell cards![/h1]
Some spell/minion cards will have dummy images for now.  They will be done soon!
*User idea cards:  they also have dummy images for now so don't hate us yet when you see having the same image as other cards!
[h1]Speaking of cards! you can now have up to whopping 20 cards in your deck.[/h1]

[h1]We tweaked the game system a little bit.[/h1]
You now spend 20 Gold to draw card instead of 40 Gold.
[h1]Card Equipment System[/h1] aka the system that no one seems to be taking advantage of...=(
- As long as you have any AP left, you can equip a card.
- The cost for that card is reduced by the remaining AP you used to equip.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/kuP9EUr.gif[/img]

[h1]New Game Modes! (win conditions)[/h1]
Duel:  Defeat the enemy hero to win.
Annihilation: KIll the Enemy Hero and all his minions to win.
Rush: Roll around the board as many times as indicated to win.
Hunt: Kill the designated minion(s) to win.
Collect:  Collect all the items scattered around the board to win.
Deliver: Get the designated item and race to the Starting Space.
Giant Boss: Defeat the boss who can grow to giant-size, to win.

*Don't forget to check the win condition on the top!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RLUNje7.jpg[/img]

[h1]English Localization[/h1]
It's still being reviewed, and you may notice some grammatical mistakes here and there and may even see some inappropriate expressions.  It will be polished for sure before the full launch.

[h1]Others[/h1]
[h1]*Unforunately all your progression so far will be lost with this update.  Sorry guys![/h1]
Improved sound effects and animations.
We got rid of the Artifact System because it just made things complicated.

notes.title: The stuff we're working on. The card idea winners.
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eZgKajT.jpg[/img]
Hey guys,

I suddenly got this urge to share with you guys what we've been working on over the last few weeks.  We're experimenting with a bunch of new stuff which will probably be introduced in our next update, the date for which is yet to be set.  It may take awhile until that update but we will use every minute of that time to make the game more exciting and polished and make the wait all worthwhile.


[h1]Multiple saves[/h1]
Let's not worry about losing your save now when you play a new character. (Hm..have I already told you about this?)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1eMhEOb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battle Log[/h1]
Which will help you get a better understanding of what on earth is going on. (Look at the texts on the bottom left corner in the image below.)

[h1]Back to one dice[/h1]
For more interactions, and others.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zGnb8Nj.gif[/img]

[h1]Relic Hunter[/h1]
He has awaken, and he's got some treasure chests you can't refuse.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QA0t4Sg.gif[/img]

[h1]Deck limit now up to 20[/h1]
More cards mean more strategies and fun.

[h1]Give Taunt or Level[/h1]
When you land on one of your friendly minions, you can give it Taunt or raise its level.  Of course nothing comes free.  It takes Gold.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aqiUn8L.gif[/img]

[h1]Complete renovation of the storyline[/h1]
We're spicing things up.  It will return longer and funnier, and of course with more parodies.


[h1]The card ideas, Winners![/h1]
I want to first thank all the participants.  We had a lot of fun reading your  ideas.  Congratulations to the winners, and those of you who didn't win, don't be disappointed because there will be next time!  Please note that these cards maybe tweaked to a certain extent while it makes a transition into the game.

hellfirebam
Trapmaster 4/4
Up to 3 random empty spaces become spike traps. Death

Kenibatz
Single Strike Soldier 10/10
Remove this minion from the game after one lap.Taunt, Summon

Kenibatz 
Sleepy Sentinel 10/10
Once per lap, -2 attack. Taunt, One Lap

Kenibatz
Twisted Faith 3
You and your enemy swap minion ownership for one lap.

Rhodin
Doppleganger 5
When summoned, Doppleganger gains the stats of one minion currently in play. Summon

We also got a few cards we came up on our own.  I will reveal them later so stay tuned.

[h1]April Fools image that didn't quite make it[/h1]
I will leave you guys with our April Fools Day image that almost made it but we decided not to post because it wasn't funny enough...
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RsRMlD7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tell us your card idea!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Do you have a good card idea?  Then you don't want to miss this!

[h1][b]Tell us your card ideas and it can be included in the game![/b][/h1]

No pressure.  Just let your imagination fly.  Should it be funny? technical?  Doesn't matter! (But if it's funny, technical, and unique, the better!)  Should it be a minion card or a spell card?  It can be any type of card!  Just one thing.  Please follow the following format.

[h1]Class / Card Name / Cost / Ability / How is this ability triggered?[/h1]

Here's an example:  
[h1]Warrior/ / Taunt Giver / 3AP / Give Taunt to your Hero / When it's summoned.[/h1]

Here's a tip.  Please keep the description as short and clear as possible. (If you can't, that's fine too =)  [u]We will pick a winner for each class, and implement it in the game.[/u] *Please note that we may edit it to a certain extent to make it more fit for the game.

If your idea gets picked, you will get the following prizes.

- You will receive a Dicetiny Steam key.
- Your Steam ID will be mentioned in the game as the inspiration.

[i]Like this! but this is just an example and it could be on the back of the card.  
We haven't decided yet.[/i]

Alright guys.  It's time for that light bulb moment!  Leave your idea below or send it to master@fakedice.com

notes.title: Major Update Done! Now What? - The Details of Our Monday Meeting!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Hope you guys enjoyed the recent update! =)  For us, we had an important meeting this Monday to decide which direction we should be heading from this point on.  We sat down to discuss what we should be focusing on to make DICETINY a complete game.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KEh5KyU.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Launch your game for update. Patch note is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eZuBJwe.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

The wait is finally over.  Here's the patch note for today's update.  Enjoy, and let us know what you think of the update!  (Please note that if you haven't participated in the recent beta test, your previous progression will be lost.  Sorry about the inconvenience guys.)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/isJJvpN.jpg[/img]

[h1]The price will change from 75% off to 60% off[/h1]
As we announced when we launched the game on Early Access, we are increasing the price as more content is being added. (It will take a few days until this price change goes effective after this upcoming update because it takes a few days to get Valve's confirmation after we change the price.)

[h1]New features[/h1]
- World Map
- Campfire
- Relics
- Reward System
*Click here to read the update preview num.1 for more details.  http://steamcommunity.com/games/318090/announcements/detail/970893244358416242

[h1]New enemy characters[/h1]
- Zeki Ernest, Britney Showy, Leif Showy, Helmeted Horror, and T-alek added.
*Click here to read the update preview num.2 for more details.  http://steamcommunity.com/games/318090/announcements/detail/970893970519671818

[h1]Randomized event space.[/h1]
- Now the position of each event space on the four corners of the board (Starting Space, The Shop, Temple of Bless) is randomized at the start of a game.

[h1]Card Storage System added[/h1]
- "Drag and drop card" in the card storage to save it for later use.  Watch this video from 03:15 to see how this works.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pqgrSaJB5sA

[h1]Board Conditions added[/h1]
- Board conditions are rules you and your enemy must follow.
- They are not stage-specific and randomly assigned to a stage each time you play.
- There are six conditions as below.
[list]
[*]The Wrath of God:  A lightening strikes on 1~3 random spaces in the beginning of every turn.
[*]Sticky:  All heroes move one space less after rolling the dice.
[*]Greasy:  All heroes move one space further after rolling the dice.
[*]Become a Rich:  Both heroes start the game with 500 gold.
[*]Recycled Card:  Every time a card is used, it returns to its deck.
[*]Thick Fog:  You can't use spell cards on spaces with fog. The fog moves randomly every round.
[/list]

[h1]Minion Bribery System[/h1]
Both enemy and neutral minions can be bribed.
You can now check the bribery probability rate by hovering on a minion (enemy/neutral)

[h1]Others[/h1]
- Improved the HUD.
- Added new cards.
- Improved special effects
- Each Hero's skills adjusted
- Each Hero has a different One Lap Bonus
- Fixed bugs
- Improved English translation. (want to give a shoutout to Matt from Minnesota who kindly helped us with the English translation.  Thank you Matt!)

[h1]The road to find the greatest Steam banner of all time.[/h1]
The Winner!  Thank you everyone who participated in the poll.  Don't forget to click it when you see this. =)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PgDf6w6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Preview Num.1 (Wolrd Map, Campfire, Relics)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lDM62Qm.jpg[/img]
Hi guys!

Before I begin today's update, I want to recap the yesterday's highlights.

[h1]There will be an update...[/h1]
...This Thursday night February 18th! (PST) This update will add a few exciting new features, and you can think of it as a polished version of the beta test version some of you recently played. 

[h1]The price will change from 75% off to 60% off[/h1]
As we announced when we launched the game on Early Access, we are increasing the price as more content is being added. (It will take a few days until this price change goes effective after this upcoming update because it takes a few days to get Valve's confirmation after we change the price.) So some of you who hasn't gotten Dicetiny yet, this is the best time to get it!

[h1]Our journey to find the greatest Steam banner of all time (!?)[/h1]
First of all, thank you for participating in the yesterday's poll for the greatest banner of all time on Steam.  It was the most comments we've ever seen here.  We will probably do this sort of thing more often, so stay tuned guys.  Those of you who missed it, it's not too late btw.  Go here to cast your vote! -> [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/318090/announcements/detail/970893244354928595]Click[/url]  The winner will be announced...this Thursday!  

Now let's take a look at what kind of changes you will see in the upcoming update.  Let's go!

[h1]World Map[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/B5IWCMD.gif[/img]
[i]Tada![/i]
inspired by the maps from classic games like Super Mario, you can challenge the stages that are currently unlocked in any order you wish as long as they are unlocked, however we're currently considering to make this a linear progression for most of the stages. Some stages are locked at first but clearing stages with a castle will unlock them. The goal of the game is to clear all the stages within a certain number of days given (In this case, 28 days) with each stage costing 1 day if you play it, which means if you die in a stage, that counts as 1 day, and retrying it will cost another 1 day. If you fail to clear all the stages within 28 days, the world is doomed, and will be ravaged by the ruthless force of Dead Serious.

[h1]Campfire[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zU0uGpO.gif[/img]
Campfire is where you can buy minion/spell cards as well as relics with the GEMs you earned by clearing stages. You can also manage your decks and relics. Entering Campfire costs 1 day so think carefully before you make that decision.

[h1]Relics[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gEumKsD.jpg[/img]
Relics are passive skills that are triggered if your dice show a certain number. Each relic is assigned with a number, and the relic's skill is activated when that your dice show that number. You can unlock relics by clearing stages, and can equip up to three of them to your hero.

Btw you can watch me talking about these new features in this recent video I posted:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pqgrSaJB5sA

Alright guys, I will be back tomorrow with more details on the upcoming update.  Have a great day!
Mike "The People's Community Manager"

inspired by the maps from classic games like Super Mario, you can challenge the stages that are currently unlocked in any order you wish as long as they are unlocked, however we're currently considering to make this a linear progression for most of the stages. Some stages are locked at first but clearing stages with a castle will unlock them. The goal of the game is to clear all the stages within a certain number of days given (In this case, 28 days) with each stage costing 1 day if you play it, which means if you die in a stage, that counts as 1 day, and retrying it will cost another 1 day. If you fail to clear all the stages within 28 days, the world is doomed, and will be ravaged by the ruthless force of Dead Serious.

[h1]Campfire[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zU0uGpO.gif[/img]
Campfire is where you can buy minion/spell cards as well as relics with the GEMs you earned by clearing stages. You can also manage your decks and relics. Entering Campfire costs 1 day so think carefully before you make that decision.

[h1]Relics[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gEumKsD.jpg[/img]
Relics are passive skills that are triggered if your dice show a certain number. Each relic is assigned with a number, and the relic's skill is activated when that your dice show that number. You can unlock relics by clearing stages, and can equip up to three of them to your hero.

Btw you can watch me talking about these new features in this recent video I posted:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pqgrSaJB5sA

Alright guys, I will be back tomorrow with more details on the upcoming update.  Have a great day!
Mike "The People's Community Manager"

notes.title: Reddit AMA this Thursday (EST), and Beta test coming next week!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5RZ58ct.jpg[/img]
Hey guys,

Yesterday morning we had our weekly meeting.  Some of you may already know, but most of us now work from home, and our physical beings only get together on Mondays to regroup and discuss any topic related to the development of the game as well as geeky/nerdy gossips like how much we liked the recent Star Wars movie although they completely changed the original storyline.  In today's announcement I want to give you some insights on what was discussed during that meeting, and what we decided to do in the near future.

[h1]Should we update the game this Friday as planned?[/h1]
- This was of course the most important topic of the meeting.  As we quietly announced on [url=https://twitter.com/YourDICETINY/status/684619094889345024]Twitter[/url], we were planning to do an update this Friday.  However, we had a problem.  The game needs more polishing.  Bugs should be fixed as well as texts.  The game balance should be adjusted not to mention other small works to raise the quality level.  So here's what we talked about regarding this... 

[h1]How about we do a beta test to polish the game before we do any update?[/h1]
A:  This beta will focus on polishing the game with help from user reports.
B:  Not a bad idea.  Yeah I'm down with that.
A:  So do that next week?
B:  Yup let's do it.  So the focus of this beta test will be to polish the game.  We have to clearly inform people of that.
A:  Absolutely.  How about we make it clear on the announcement?
B:  The thing is...many people don't read announcements, it has to be visible in-game.
A:  How about we make a splash screen with a FBI warning that this test focuses on polishing the game?
B:  Sold!  Let's do it!

So...that's what was discussed.  So to summarize this, there will be a beta next week with new features/stages and everything, and our focus will be to polish the game by catching bugs and crashes as well as correcting English and adjusting the balance/raising the overall quality, among others.  The details on how to participate in this beta test will be revealed through an announcement next week, so please stay tuned. (Anyone who owns Dicetiny will be able to participate in the test)

So I'm sure you guys still have some questions regarding this, and I felt that we need to connect more with the community so I suggested the team we do a...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/CMSkiKo.png[/img]
[h1]Reddit AMA[/h1]
Since the time we launched Kickstarter campaign, this has been bugging me because many people recommended it but we have never done one.  Reddit AMA has always been on the top of my "To do list".  Now I'm happy to tell you that it's happening for real this Thursday night at 9pm EST .  Please prepare your questions related to Dicetiny, and shoot them to us come January 21st.  But please go easy on us.  As you guys already know, we are not very good at English so this will be a challenge for us.  But we love trying new stuff, and I'm sure it will be worth a try.

So here's the schedule.

[b]When?[/b]:  January 21 Thursday starts at 21:00 ,and ends at 22:30 (EST)
That's 6pm in LA, 9pm in New York and 3am in Germany(Jan.22 for Germany), 
[b]Where?[/b]:  https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA  (Once our post is up, we will share the link on this Community Hub, Facebook, Twitter, and Tumblr.  You can find the links to these social media sites here:  http://www.fakedice.com/ )
[b]Who?[/b]:  Jin (CEO), Sun-geun (Game Designer/QA), and Mike (Community Manager) will be there to answer your questions.  Mike (That's me) will translate for Jin and Sun-geun as they speak limited English.

[h1]UIs renovated[/h1]
https://youtu.be/jFV558DsK6c
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CY_0LC4UQAADsvM.jpg:large[/img]
We renovated the UIs and here's what we discussed.

A: What is "Storage Slot"?  
B: It's where you can keep one of your cards so you can use it later in the game.
A: Ok, and the starting space, it's on the top?  What's going on here.
B: The special spaces on the corners are now randomly arranged at the beginning. 
A:  Aha, to give more replay values?
B:  Exactly.
A: Btw I actually prefer the old design.
B:  Come again?

[h1]T-alek[/h1]
inspired by Dalek from Dr.Who, T-alek will be one of the new characters you will be playing against in the beta next week.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/358401569829822700/62590E9932C0C4AD111F238348A80E912C196C6E/[/img]
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/358401569829825784/E85042B6BE418533CA56586CC9082C86538ED98E/[/img]
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/358401569829828259/2E971344CFB5208450B04216888DE48EFD9D8661/[/img]

[h1]Our saviour![/h1]
A good news!  We finally found a person who was willing to help us with English.  His name is Matt.  Thank you.  Your kindness will not be forgotten.  May the dice be with you, Matt.

See you on Thursday guys!
Mike "The People's Community Manager"

notes.title: IndieDB Indie of the year & let's talk more about Campfire!
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394426781957923717/E2A6AEE3F3A2C256AB311864C73823DC4069712D/[/img]
Hey guys,

It's me, Mike, the guy who tries to speak English.   Are you guys excited about Christmas and the New Year?  Me too...  You may ask what's with the image on the top?  Well I will get to it later.  I just put it up there so people can see it when they visit the store page.

[h1]IndieDB's quest to find the best(?) 100 indie games [/h1]
So I want to start off today's newsletter with indieDB's INDIE OF THE YEAR 2015.  Did we win the award???  No...but the title of this newsletter may have tricked you into thinking that.  For some of you who are not familiar with IndieDB, it's basically an website devoted to indie games, and they're currently accepting votes to decide Top 100 indie games of 2015.  Our game still has a long way to go, but things like this is a great way to get some exposure, (looks like game media heavyweights like Eurogamer, Rock Paper Shotgun, and VG24/7 will keep their eyes on this), so if you could just head over to our indieDB page (which hadn't been updated for quite a while, but I will be updating more often from now on.  I think it's better than Tumblr to get the words out.), and hit that Vote button, that would be highly appreciated. (Of course if you think Dicetiny deserves a vote that is!)  Only ONE DAY LEFT! (It ends on Friday I think) so hurry up if you're thinking about voting.  Here's a link:  http://www.indiedb.com/games/dicetiny

[i]I already voted as you have already guessed.[/i]
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394426781957216997/3A4B666ECE742D7B12E604D7204AFE0F3E8C6742/[/img]


[h1]Campfire! (The Campfire?  not sure what to call it.)[/h1]
What is the Campfire, that is the question.
- Your hero can heal his HP here.
- Each time you enter the Campfire, you spend "One Day".  Which means you have to complete the whole game within a given time limit. (28 days for now, and the World as you know it ends...)
- So basically here, you can heal/manage your deck/manage your relics(What is relic? i will tell you more about it in later updates)/meet dealers(?)  Whoa, hold your horses, dealers?  Can you tell me more about them?  Sure thing!

There are Relic Hunter/Spell-card Dealer/Minion-card Dealer, and there's 30% chance for each of them to appear at the Campfire. (So you may see all of them one night, and none of them the other night).  Again more details on Relic will be revealed soon.  Speaking of Relic, I LOVED [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gq4JVKJcG8E] "This Show	[/url]" back in the 90's.

[i]I'm so lonely...[/i]
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394426781957916255/01E3A00BA9516819574CFCE7F8B863FCA13A959E/[/img]
[i]Awkward![/i]
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394426781957918459/848D14FD4A6CDAE02CEEAF56199148670347201F/[/img]
[i]Sup X 3[/i]
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394426781957920801/2FE33CB97577BDB6FC773A950E54AC6E65EAC160/[/img]

[h1]Here's me checking out the work-in-progress main menu.[/h1]
As you can see, we're transforming the game so that it will be more PC and RPG-like. (For some of you who don't know about our past, we'd been actually developing this game for the mobile devices for awhile and switched the focus to PC.)  And yes.  I like 80's rocks.  https://youtu.be/GwwaS7dNkF4
When can I see this update in the actual game you ask?  This big update will probably take place sometime in January.  That means no update in December?  There maybe, but it will not be a big one.  Sorry guys.

[h1]Our new indie friend, Gremlins Inc.[/h1]
No, I'm not talking about [url=http://actionflickchick.com/superaction/wp-content/uploads/2009/12/gremlins0zf.jpg]him...[/url]
I've been on the lookout for fellow indie devs with whom we can share information as well as seek possibilities together to co-promote our games, and Gremlins immediately caught my eyes.  I sent a hello email and the nice fellows in Lithuania helped us out giving us tips and introducing us to some really talented people.  We launched around similar time, and they have whopping 95% positive reviews!  The game's artstyle is the thing of envy to any indie developers.  I played about 30 minutes the other day, and if you like board games, I'm pretty sure you will be hooked immediately not just for the artstyle but also the sound effects and unique and deep gameplay.  Anyhow if you're interested, check out their store page. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/369990

I will probably continue trying to reach out to other indie developers, and this is not going to be an one time thing as I will continue to mention about the game on our social media channels.

Alright guys, I will see you guys soon.  Enjoy your destiny, and hopefully Dicetiny too.
Cheers,
Mike "The People's Community Manager"

[h1]The Campfire[/h1]
We introduce to you The Campfire! which is something we're going to add in the future update as a part of our efforts to upgrade Dicetiny's RPG elements.  Here, you can spend 1 day to do the followings.
[list]
[*][h1]Build your deck[/h1]
- Basically works the same way as what we have right now.
[h1]Manage your Relics[/h1] (or equipments..we haven't decided what to call these)

- There's 25% chance a dealer appears in camp (Just like that gnome from the Golden Axe!) who sells cards/relics.  Some of them plays a dice draw game with you and if you win, you get a random relic!
[*][h1]Check the progress of your achievements.[/h1]
- These achievements are not Steam achievements.  We wanted to keep these achievements non-Steam because there's a possibility that the game will be ported to other platform.  Steam achievements maybe added later. 

After you've done all of these things, you press Sleep or Rest button to end the day, see a short animation, and go back to the World Map.  Wait, there's one more thing on the Campfire...

- There's a chance that you will be ambushed by burglars while you're asleep. ...  I will stop here since I don't want to give out too much information. =)

the game could be run on DirectX 10 but recent reports show otherwise...)  If your graphic card supports it, please try reinstalling DirectX 11 or above.  

If the game crashes while you're in-game, please check whether the game is running on your internal graphics. If so, please switch your graphics to the external one. Here are some instructions on how to switch from internal graphics to external graphics.
https://support.lenovo.com/us/en/documents/ht078706
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PUBOYKICRso

If none of these fixes the crash, we have to suspect there's a bug in Unreal Engine 4.  We're going to see them at Gstar so we will ask them about this.

notes.title: Update #2: Optimization, FatalError, Multiplayer and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/395549511449418075/B055251847AB6C23E17ED9EBDED00D974CB627EC/[/img]

Helloooo guys,  this is MIke the Community Manager.

I'm back to share with you guys another patch.  Today's patch focuses more on optimization, fixing bugs and improving UIs here and there.  Please read below for more details on today's patch.

[h1]The end of the Halloween event. [/h1]
- All good things must come to an end including Halloween.  
- All the cool skins and background images are now back to...normal. See you again on next Halloween!
- Except...Jace.  She will stay with you even after the Halloween party, which means you can still play as her.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
We got many comments about Dicetiny running not very smoothly especially on low-spec PCs/Macs/Laptops.  Our programmers worked hard to optimize our game as much as possible, and now we're little more happier about it.  So we reduced the video card memory usage, so those of you running the game on low spec PCs or OSX or Laptop will be able to play the game more smoothly.  Please let us know how this goes on your computer.

[h1]And here are some of other things we improved with this patch.[/h1]
- We moved the position of "the arrow" that takes you to the next page in MY DECK little lower to make it more visible.
- Now you don't have to wonder how the hell you can zoom-in on a card in MY DECK, because we added a text that says "Please click and hold a card to zoom-in."  Some of you suggested right-clicking to zoom-in so..maybe in the future we may consider this.
[b]- Now text boxes stay longer so you guys can enjoy the very EXCITING dialogue between characters for now, but In the next patch, we're planning to add a button that lets you skip each text box.  Hooray![/b]
- Alright streamers, now you don't have to worry about that annoying Volume control that never worked.  You can now turn down (or up) the volume so that your sexy voice is heard more clearly.

[h1]And meanwhile at Fakedice...[/h1]
In an effort to be more candid about what we're up to, and our plan for the future, I'm sharing here some of the topics we discussed in our weekly meeting that took place this Monday.  These are some of the things we discussed.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/395549511449392659/F5AE290626E11E90866E12D3C873BD8310947A59/[/img]
[i]Here's us[/i]

[h1]Fatal Error and other errors.[/h1]
First of all, we apologize for this error guys.  I think not having enough beta-testing before Early Access is costing us.  But the good news is, the latest improvement in the optimization department may solve this issue to some degree, well at least we hope so.  So try this latest build and let us know if this solved that issue for you guys.  It hurts us to see all the negative comments because of this...(sniff, sniff)  Anyhow we're doing our best guys so we ask for your patience.  (we partly blame Epic for their very complicated engine)

[h1]Some of the other known issues...[/h1]
- If you hover the mouse cursor over a minion card during a battle, the minion card moves to the cursor.
- If you hover the cursor over a miinon that's just been placed, the zoomed-in card sometimes doesn't disappear.

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
Ok, another thing that we talked about in our meeting is Multiplayer.  We know some of you guys want Multiplayer a lot, and our current build has a lot of PvP feel to it, but we decided to focus on Singleplayer for now for the following reasons.  We don't have enough user-base for smooth Multiplayer experience.  We don't want you guys to wait for an opponent for half an hour and leave with bad taste in mouth.  Second, we don't have enough manpower + time/money to implement multiplayer at the moment.  Balancing, and setting up servers will take time and money.  And with our current resource, we decided in stead of making half-complete multiplayer, we will make complete singleplayer that is fun and full of surprises.  Now we're not putting multiplayer aside for good.  Multiplayer will be our highest priority if the conditions are met.  So we're sorry if this disappoints some of you, and we understand that but that's our current situation.

[h1]More RPG elements in plan, and other things we discussed.[/h1]
So since we will be focused more on Singleplayer, you will be seeing more RPG elements in the future updates.  Some of the ideas we discussed were, having a big map with many missions, and you can freely complete each mission without any order within a given days, maybe 28 days? Helloooo guys,  this is MIke the Community Manager.

Our programmers worked hard to optimize our game as much as possible, and now we're little more happier about it.  So we reduced the video card memory usage, so those of you running the game on low spec PCs or OSX or Laptop will be able to play the game more smoothly.  Please let us know how this goes on your computer.

[h1]And here are some of other things we improved with this patch.[/h1]
- We moved the position of "the arrow" that takes you to the next page in MY DECK little lower to make it more visible.

notes.title: One more guest is coming to your Halloween party...
notes.content:
[img]https://glip-vault-1.s3.amazonaws.com/web/customer_files/28485476364/modified.jpg?Expires=2075494478&AWSAccessKeyId=AKIAJROPQDFTIHBTLJJQ&Signature=nY%2Bgyk%2FHPkGv21ohI%2FjpCU2%2FoTo%3D[/img]

Hi guys!

My name is Mike, and I'm your community manager.  Why am I a community manager?  Although to a limited extent, I'm the only who speaks English.  (Anyone interested in helping us with English, please let us know!)

How has your experience been so far playing Dicetiny?  (Those of you still experiencing technical difficulties, we're working hard to find the cause of it, especially the Fatal Error one.)  Were the texts too fast to read?  Did you think the AI was too stupid when the succubus killed herself?  Did you think the English was horrible? (sigh...)  Did you wonder where the hell was your New Card?  Hopefully we can get those things sorted out soon.  Thank you for playing Diceitny guys, and we're looking forward to making this game with you.  

So today I have a good news,  I'm here to let you know that there will be DICETINY's first patch this Friday.  But before we get into that.  we want to explain to you how we will proceed with updates in the future.  There will be "Three Types" of updates.

[h1]1. Major Updates:[/h1]
Takes place every 1~2 months
Will add major content
There will be a price raise from $4.99. (but if you already purchased the game, you will get all updates for free)

[h1]2. Minior Update & Hotfix:[/h1]
Will take place after 1 or 2 weeks after major update after hearing user feedback.
Will mostly cover balancing, bug fixes, and other small changes.
There will be no price raise.

[h1]3. Special Update:[/h1]
Non pre-scheduled "Event Type" updates.

Alright so those are the three types of patches.  So returning to what I was talking about...our first patch will be a minior patch, and we will call it Halloween patch..for obvious reasons.  And on Halloween, what do you do?  You party right?  And what good is a party if there's no guests?  That's right a guest.  A guest will pay a visit on [u][b]October 30th[/b][/u].  Who you ask?  You will find out this Friday....  We saw a glimpse of this mysterious person today morning while we were jogging in the forest...
